description: Deletes one view's recipe from Development — the dashboard's own delete, at once, with no approval; the collection and its records are untouched, only the view's recipe goes. Never Live, even by request: a view's recipe reaches Live only through promotion, which adds and updates views and never removes one, so a view promoted once stays in Live for good. put_view makes the Development view again. On the founder's Logs.
name: dev_delete_view
title: Development: delete a view
